parameters.query:
UPDATE typeform_surveys
SET points_result = {{ $('Code - Normalize Points Result').item.json.sqlPointsResultExpr }}
WHERE hash = '{{ $('Code - Normalize Points Result').item.json.sqlHash }}'
  AND (
    points_result IS NULL
    OR points_result = ''
    OR (CASE
  WHEN points_result LIKE '%Ja interessiert%' OR points_result LIKE '%Aktuell nicht interessant%' OR points_result LIKE '%Yes, interested%' OR points_result LIKE '%Not interesting right now%' OR points_result LIKE '%Si, interessato%' OR points_result LIKE CONCAT('%', CONVERT(0x533f2c20696e74657265737361746f USING utf8mb4), '%') OR points_result LIKE '%Al momento non interessante%' OR points_result LIKE '%Oui, interesse%' OR points_result LIKE CONCAT('%', CONVERT(0x4f75692c20696e743f726573733f USING utf8mb4), '%') OR points_result LIKE '%Pas interessant actuellement%' OR points_result LIKE CONCAT('%', CONVERT(0x50617320696e743f72657373616e742061637475656c6c656d656e74 USING utf8mb4), '%') OR points_result LIKE '%Da, interesno%' OR points_result LIKE '%Seichas ne interesno%' OR points_result LIKE CONCAT('%', CONVERT(0x3f3f2c203f3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3f USING utf8mb4), '%') OR points_result LIKE CONCAT('%', CONVERT(0x3f3f3f3f3f3f203f3f203f3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3f USING utf8mb4), '%') THEN 4
  WHEN points_result LIKE 'Alle 3 Videos angeschaut%' OR points_result LIKE 'All 3 videos watched%' OR points_result LIKE 'Tutti e 3 i video guardati%' OR points_result LIKE CONCAT(CONVERT(0x4c65732033207669643f6f73207265676172643f6573 USING utf8mb4), '%') OR points_result LIKE CONCAT(CONVERT(0x3f3f3f2033203f3f3f3f3f203f3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3f USING utf8mb4), '%') THEN 4
  WHEN points_result LIKE '%3/3%' OR points_result LIKE 'Alle 3%' OR points_result LIKE 'All 3%' OR points_result LIKE 'Tutti e 3%' OR points_result LIKE 'Les 3%' OR points_result LIKE CONCAT(CONVERT(0x3f3f3f2033 USING utf8mb4), '%') THEN 3
  WHEN points_result LIKE '%2/3%' THEN 2
  WHEN points_result LIKE '%1/3%' THEN 1
  WHEN points_result LIKE '%2%' THEN 2
  WHEN points_result LIKE '%3%' THEN 3
  WHEN points_result LIKE '%1%' THEN 1
  ELSE 0
END) <= {{ $('Code - Normalize Points Result').item.json.newRank }}
  )

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS matchedRows,
  SUM(CASE WHEN points_result = {{ $('Code - Normalize Points Result').item.json.sqlPointsResultExpr }} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS labelRows,
  MAX(points_result) AS currentPointsResult
FROM typeform_surveys
WHERE hash = '{{ $('Code - Normalize Points Result').item.json.sqlHash }}'
